description: This file defines the interface IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory for creating various WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, set caps, eos, set volume, write buffer, and handle bus message within the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for creating these tasks, which return unique pointers to IPlayerTask objects, and references external classes and structures like WebAudioPlayerContext, IGstWebAudioPlayerPrivate, and GstMessage.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: An interface class that provides factory methods for creating WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, set caps, eos, set volume, write buffer, and handle bus message.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a Shutdown task for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a Stop task for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a Play task for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a Pause task for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a SetCaps task with specified context, mime type, and optional configuration.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates an End of Stream (EOS) task.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a SetVolume task with specified volume.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a WriteBuffer task with specified data pointers and lengths.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle a bus message.
